items.title: Bill Mays interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 5, 2025
items.q: I ended with Renee Rosnes. But that was the program I did there three years ago.

ctx.x: I’d like to do a little compare and contrast here, looking at your itinerary on your website I noticed one of your last gigs was at the Norton Museum of Art. And can you just tell me a little bit about that gig?

Well it was a couple of Sundays ago, there’s a wonderful collection, very eclectic, small by comparison with big museums, the Norton Museum of Art in West Palm Beach. And I had done a program for them three years ago called “A Brief History of Jazz Piano” where I did about 22 piano players starting with Jelly Roll, going up to I think I ended with Herbie Han – no I ended with Renee Rosnes. But that was the program I did there three years ago. You’re asking about what I did a couple of weeks ago. I picked 80 of my…
Oh that’s fascinating. So can you compare that with your first gig when you were 15?
